column1: # Owner -> subsystem map for tools/coverage.py (RE side). One row per owner pattern; the FIRST matching row wins.
#   pattern    "m:<Class>::<Method>" for one function (wins over owner rows; partial shadows), or an
#              fnmatch glob (case-sensitive) on the owner: a class or namespace ("cSC4PowerSimulator",
#              "nSGLDX7::cGDriver"; nested classes match their parent's pattern with "*"), or "fn:<name>" for a free
#   subsystem  the row's name in the report (several rows may share one)
#   area       simulation | framework | renderer | ui | audio | region | other
#   spec       docs/specs files that specify this owner as their subject, comma-separated, or - . A spec that only
#              mentions a class, or covers one method of it, does not count (short forms count for what they list)
#   core       engine/ paths of the clean-room module(s) that implement it (core/src/..., formats/src/...), or -
#   shadow     the ini key of the same-process shadow that compares it with the original, or -
#   replace    the ini enable key (engine/plugin/FC4Subsystems.cpp) that swaps the original class for ours, or -
# Status rules (tools/coverage.py, docs/COVERAGE.md): specified = every listed spec file exists; implemented = every
# listed core path exists; verified = the shadow is in the regress shadows list and exact (every line clean) in the
# regress .out read; replaced = the key is in the regress replace list (or on by default) and the replace run was clean.
# ---- simulation: simulators and developers with a spec, a core, a shadow or a replacement

# weather_shadow (glue-weather-propdev6 applying WE1; house profile from train180) replays the native weather simulator's daily step through core/src/weather and compares wind and moisture exactly each month: 73/73, zero resyncs (run 5)

# cVecRange: the series range walk of history.md §4.6 (HW6, constructor 0x00475B00); only the history warehouse calls it
